description.value: Homebrew: marker effect present on the actor while shapeshifted into Weredragon's Hybrid form. Uses the same icon as the "Weredragon Form: Hybrid" hotbar macro. Granted automatically by that macro, the initiative form-shift prompt, or any other trigger that calls scripts/weredragon-form-shift.js's shiftWeredragonForm(actor, "hybrid") -- not meant to be dragged onto a sheet manually. Removed automatically when switching to Animal or Humanoid form.
